name: Retro
intent: Printed ephemera: a warm cream stock, two inks, small hard offsets instead of shadows, and a texture that admits it was printed - the palette of a 1970s poster rather than a screen.

do: Keep to two inks plus the cream stock, and let the cream be the lightest thing on the page.
Use the warm accent for one band, rule or chip - it is the second colour, not a third.
Offset a panel by a few pixels with a hard shadow in ink to make it feel letterpressed.
Let the texture sit at a low opacity so it reads as stock rather than noise.
dont: Do not use a cool grey anywhere - it kills the warmth instantly.
Do not use a soft or coloured shadow; the offset is always ink.

gates: Body contrast is at least 4.5:1 on the cream stock.
The ink offset is visible at 100% and never blurred.
